verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Vercel exposing its own capabilities as tools for AI agents (vercel-docs-4, vercel-docs-15) and building agent infrastructure (Workflow SDK, AI Gateway), but there is no evidence that Vercel itself can act as an MCP client, ingesting external MCP servers so it can use their tools. Missing for 10: any documentation of Vercel connecting to third-party MCP servers as a client and invoking their tools.
